channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Watch: A 'friendly neighbor' helps someone in need
item.description: Christopher Hellenthal, still in his Spiderman costume from a children's superhero event, rushed to help a man in a wheelchair cross the street.

item.title: Seattle police search for two men who parachuted from Space Needle
item.description: Two men climbed over the glass barrier of Seattle's Space Needle on Friday and parachuted from the 605-foot structure, police said.

item.title: US suspends strikes on Iran as diplomatic talks show progress
item.description: Sources told CBS News that negotiations between Oman and Iran over reopening the Strait of Hormuz and waterways have advanced.

item.title: GOP Rep. Turner says Trump has limited options on Iran
item.description: Rep. Mike Turner argued the US should keep pressuring Iran but acknowledged Trump has few choices while Iran retains voting power.
